title: RedrawRecord
description: A deviation routed back through the design: the machine-readable form of "add it neatly later".

deviation.description: The deviation this resolves: a review record and the delta it named.

directedBy.description: The direction row that PARKS this redraw. `parked` without it is refused in the same terms `signed` without a sign-off row is ([2026] VJS-CA-VDS 1 order 27).

proposed.description: The proposed design change, described. A DESCRIPTION of intent, never a value: the change itself happens in the design file.

resolvedBy.description: The sign-off row that resolves this redraw. `signed` without it is refused by the proof: a deviation is resolvable ONLY by a sign-off row whose hash covers the change, never by the word "signed".

reviewId.description: The review that recorded the deviation, where one exists.

DirectionId.description: A registered Principal direction: the sign-off register's second row kind, hash-bound to its logged decision ([2026] VJS-CA-VDS 1 order 26).

RedrawId.description: A proposed redraw: a deviation routed back through the design, never through an exception (draft S-7D).

RedrawStatus.description: Where a proposed redraw stands. CLOSED at four; there is no "accepted".

oneOf.description: The change is described and owed to the design.
The change has been drawn and awaits sign-off.

PARKED under a registered Principal direction ([2026] VJS-CA-VDS 1 order 27, giving effect to [2026] VJS-SC-OPBOX 1 order 29).

Lawful ONLY with a `directedBy` naming a [`DirectionRecord`] whose `decisionDigest` still matches. A parked subject retains its render rights and is reported and never fatal: while the registered direction stands no gate may count it a violation.

This is NOT the acceptance state returning. An acceptance was a verdict the ENGINE reached about a difference; a park is a direction the Principal gave, recorded at the register and hash-bound to its own log entry, which is where the constitutional direction puts taste.
A sign-off row covering the change exists. ONLY lawful with `resolved_by` naming it; the proof refuses the word without the row.

The proposal is ABANDONED and the deviation stands.

Documented as what it is, per [2026] VJS-CA-VDS 1 order 27: it was briefly the only status a direction could be squeezed into, and it says the opposite of what a direction means. A direction is recorded as `parked` with a covering direction row, never here.

ReviewId.description: A visual review verdict: automated eyes over a shipped screen against its signed frame (draft S-7D).

SignoffId.description: A frame sign-off: the frame's content hash at the moment taste was exercised (draft S-7D).

Timestamp.description: UTC, second resolution, trailing Z. The one canonical form VDS writes.
